_readme: Wikipedia insource sweep (scripts/wikipedia-insource.py): every article whose source mentions the configured phrases, with the sentences that mention it; is_company from the infobox; in_base/in_excluded resolved against the investor's rows. Candidates = company articles not in the base; the judge cites the article and its underlying reference.
